start.speaker: whisper
start.text: Door. Good. I have swept this room twice for listeners and found one: me. I have been reporting on you to nobody, out of habit, and the reports are getting embarrassing. They say you are all right.

choices.text: Keep filing them. I like knowing someone is watching.
You do not owe anyone a report any more. Not even you.
Sweep it again. I want to be sure.

free.speaker: whisper
free.text: That is the worst thing anyone has ever said to me. Say it again tomorrow.
